structure.unit: Regulation of Medical Care Facilities and Services
Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care Center Licensing

text.section: The regulations promulgated by the Board to carry out the provisions of this article shall be in substantial conformity to the standards of health, hygiene, sanitation, construction, and safety as established and recognized by medical and health care professionals and by specialists in matters of public health and safety, including the regulations of the Board of Education for child day centers, and as deemed relevant to Centers by the Board.
